At some point after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] '''captured''' the planet [[Basilisk]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]], led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]], were dispatched by [[New Republic High Command/Legends|New Republic High Command]] onto the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], where they destroyed a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] that powered [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], placed an electrified net over a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] launch chute and grounded a wing of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], and penetrated the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Nistola]]'s heavily armed flying fortress, forcing his surrender. A New Republic invasion force led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garret]] then landed and was able to take the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] without firing a shot.<ref name="GaW" />
